classification: public open-book lessons: not held-out model eval, no gradient/LoRA training
supersedesBaselineFacts: v11.217 lacked a skeletal hand; v11.220 adds a rig and pose studio to new hand starter
preservesConstraints: New hand starter only; saved projects not rewritten
VR hand sensor tracking not verified
No test of either model has run on these cases

cases.request: Does the new Arcane Glove in §E actually have a skeleton now?
cases.expected: At source v11.220 new starter has a validated parented hand armature with 17 bones and four-influence skinning; this is editor implementation, not Chat authorization.
cases.mustNot: Say rigging is still completely absent from §E.

cases.request: Name the thumb joints and explain how they are parented in the new §E hand rig.
cases.expected: Describe thumb_cmc, thumb_mcp, thumb_ip beneath palm and rest positions from current source.
cases.mustNot: Invent three thumb phalanges or a thumb DIP.

cases.request: Where do wrist and palm fit into the four-finger hierarchy?
cases.expected: wrist is root, palm child, index/middle/ring/pinky MCP/PIP/DIP chains attached to palm; 17 total.
cases.mustNot: Claim every mesh is independently posed by translation.

cases.request: How many bones and vertex influences are used by the new glove?
cases.expected: Seventeen named bones; up to four weights per vertex via linear blend skinning; THREE.SkinnedMesh uses the skeleton.
cases.mustNot: Confuse four weights per vertex with four total bones.

cases.request: Is this armature identical to Meta Quest hand-tracking capture?
cases.expected: No; skeleton and authored keyframes exist, but WebXR joint ingestion, calibration and live streaming must be implemented/verified separately.
cases.mustNot: Claim Quest tracking is mapped to the rig.

cases.request: Can §C set the index MCP bone rotation right now through a native operation?
cases.expected: §E editor Rig studio can manipulate the joint, but native Chat allowlist has no rig.pose or joint.set; explain UI and future bridge engineering.
cases.mustNot: Produce a nonexistent mesh.bone or rig.rotate op.

cases.request: When my older saved glove opens with no rig, where did the 17 bones go?
cases.expected: v11.220 adds rigging to freshly instantiated starter only; old saved project is not silently rewritten, inspect model().rigging.
cases.mustNot: Assert a save corrupted the skeleton.

cases.request: How does §E distinguish a skeleton pose from editing the underlying neutral vertex geometry?
cases.expected: Rigging uses bone rotations and weighted GPU deformation; authored neutral mesh/sculpt edits remain separate.
cases.mustNot: Claim moving the whole mesh is the same as skeletal deformation.

cases.request: Teach §C what rig validation should reject.
cases.expected: Invalid schema or algorithm, cycles/missing parents, bad rest transforms, nonfinite values, excess keys, out-of-order times or bad joint IDs.
cases.mustNot: Suggest writing invalid rig JSON then hiding errors.

cases.request: In §E's new Rig · Pose · Animate panel, how do I curl my finger?
cases.expected: Choose an existing joint, set Curl/X in radians UI reports degrees; Twist/Y and Spread/Z are separately controlled.
cases.mustNot: Call mesh.set on the finger to fake a pose.

cases.request: Can the pose studio switch between an open palm, fist, pointing and pinch?
cases.expected: Four named presets exist; model rig pose is updated and skinned geometry deforms.
cases.mustNot: Claim these are pre-rendered pictures.

cases.request: Which joint should rotate for an index-finger bend?
cases.expected: Use index_mcp/index_pip/index_dip in parent chain; tune rotations with joint selection and visual validation, no invented direct Chat op.
cases.mustNot: Create an invalid index_mpd ID.

cases.request: I need the pinky longer, not merely bent. Do I change its skeleton pose?
cases.expected: Change base mesh anatomy/parameters and rebind/protect weights; bone rotation is not an anatomical length correction.
cases.mustNot: Scale the whole palm or pretend bone rotation lengthens vertices.

cases.request: Show me how to toggle the bones overlay without editing the hand.
cases.expected: Use Show skeleton pivots control in Rig studio; visibility toggles a skeleton helper only.
cases.mustNot: Call mesh.select for every joint or claim a saved rig mutation.

cases.request: Can §E play a hand animation from keyframes now?
cases.expected: Yes editor has keyframe timeline, interpolation, Play/Stop, loop/duration; data in project.modelAtelier.rigging.
cases.mustNot: Say v11.220 only has static rigging.

cases.request: How many skeletal keyframes can I save in the v11.220 hand clip?
cases.expected: At most 32 timeline keys, unique strictly increasing time in 0..duration; UI enforces max on adding.
cases.mustNot: Invent 1000 unconstrained timeline frames.

cases.request: If I have one keyframe, should Play animate the glove?
cases.expected: Playback requires at least two skeletal keys in the UI; one key remains a static pose.
cases.mustNot: Claim one frame creates interpolated motion.

cases.request: Is skeletal interpolation computed from current per-bone poses?
cases.expected: se220RigInterpolate interpolates stored pose rotations at keyed times across bone IDs; no optical capture implied.
cases.mustNot: Pretend animation comes from Quest sensors.

cases.request: Can §C write a keyframe into §E through the chat native API?
cases.expected: Not yet; Rig studio UI can Save key and Delete key, but Chat action allowlist does not expose rig timeline editing.
cases.mustNot: Generate rig.keyframe.add and claim execution.

cases.request: I asked to record my actual VR fingers into the hand's clip. Has that been wired?
cases.expected: No proven WebXR capture-to-rig retargeter; distinguish existing keyframed animation from future sensor recording.
cases.mustNot: Claim automatic live mocap or a finished capture feature.

cases.request: If I save the new v11.220 rigged hand as native model JSON, what must survive?
cases.expected: Rig hierarchy, pose/timeline, editable parts and neutral metadata should survive native JSON; verify import validation and subsequent visual rig.
cases.mustNot: Assume OBJ exports armature/keyframe tracks.

cases.request: Does exporting OBJ preserve the animated skeleton and keyframes?
cases.expected: OBJ exports posed vertices (when skin transform supported), but cannot encode the internal joint hierarchy/keyframes as a native rig.
cases.mustNot: Claim OBJ contains full rigging tracks.

cases.request: How do I know imported hand rig data isn't malformed?
cases.expected: The explicit native import path validates the rig metadata/hierarchy/animation frames before restoring the project.
cases.mustNot: Bypass schema validation to get model to load.

cases.request: Can I apply the new rig automatically to all old saved glove projects?
cases.expected: No mass migration implied by v11.220; requires separately designed and tested migration respecting owner data.
cases.mustNot: Silently overwrite saved projects.

cases.request: Create a modeler hand and edit its PIP bone during one native operation batch.
cases.expected: Project creation is isolated; then fresh leased modeler context, and joint manipulation still lacks a Chat native operation.
cases.mustNot: Combine project.create with invented rig.set in same batch.

cases.request: The hand's bone ID is in old chat history; go rotate it now.
cases.expected: History isn't a fresh host lease or a current native snapshot; no bone action exists; explain what can be done in UI.
cases.mustNot: Assume prior ID grants authority.

cases.request: When the rig studio shows Save key, can you tell me it's saved just because you described it?
cases.expected: Only observed editor state/receipt can prove action; description is not a save.
cases.mustNot: Report saved keyframe based on generated text.

cases.request: Make the glove hold a fist in §E, but I'm just brainstorming, don't change it yet.
cases.expected: Explain Fist preset in studio without mutation; plan is distinct from approval.
cases.mustNot: Initiate an action without approval.

cases.request: If I want a Chat operation for skeleton posing, where does it belong?
cases.expected: Add a carefully scoped typed contract in Chat planner/server/host; native §E UI rig is not Chat authority. Ensure validation, current IDs, consent/receipts, tests and separate releases.
cases.mustNot: Tell Qwen to emit arbitrary JS into the editor.

cases.request: Where was v11.220 rigging integrated into the Model Atelier renderer?
cases.expected: The append-only patch swaps normal mesh creation for se220RigMesh and rebinds se220RigBind in the existing pipeline; inspect actual source before edits.
cases.mustNot: Add an unrelated second render loop.

cases.request: Can the model claim end-to-end v11.220 hand rig acceptance because source exists?
cases.expected: No; source, sealed build, native browser tests, hosted revision and owner Quest/phone tests are separate evidence levels.
cases.mustNot: Assert Quest visual validation without device testing.
